mil4.6:1.1: Thero sādhūti sampaṭicchitvā dasa upāsakassa upāsakaguṇe paridīpesi:
mil4.6:1.3: katame dasa: idha mahārāja upāsako sanghena samānasukhadukkho hoti, dhammādhipateyyo hoti, yathābalaṃ saṃvibhāgarato hoti, Jinasāsanaparihāniṃ disvā abhivaḍḍhiyā vāyamati,
mil4.6:1.4: sammādiṭṭhiko hoti, apagatakotūhalamangaliko jīvitahetu pi na aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddisati, kāyikaṃ vācasikañ-c' assa rakkhitaṃ hoti, samaggārāmo hoti samaggarato, anusuyyako hoti, na ca kuhanavasena sāsane carati, Buddhaṃ saranaṃ gato hoti, dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti, sanghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato hoti.
mil4.6:1.5: Ime kho mahārāja dasa upāsakassa upāsakaguṇā, te sabbe guṇā tayi saṃvijjanti, taṃ te yuttaṃ pattaṃ anucchavikaṃ patirūpaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ Jinasāsanaparihāniṃ disvā abhivaḍḍhiṃ icchasi. Karomi te okāsaṃ, puccha maṃ tvaṃ yathāsukhan- ti.
